Key Resources for nurse practitioners
The following list of guidelines can assist Nurse Practitioners in the management ­of 
patients with diabetes:
•• ADA Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes
•• American Association of Clinical Endocrinologists (AACE) medical guidelines for 
­clinical practices for developing a diabetes mellitus comprehensive care plan
•• Veterans Health Administration/US Department of Defense (VA/DOD)
•• American Association of Diabetes Educators (www.diabeteseducator.org)
